name: Profile Card
description: A profile card whose accent ring draws around an initials avatar, stats count up from zero and Follow folds its plus into a check. Lifts under a pointer spotlight.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name, set in Instrument Serif. Also the source of the avatar initials.

props.name: initials
props.description: Two letters for the avatar. Derived from the first and last word of name when left out.

props.name: role
props.description: First item of the mono meta line.

props.name: location
props.description: Second item of the mono meta line.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: IANA zone for the person’s local time, shown after the location and refreshed every 30s. null hides it.

props.name: bio
props.default: "Draws letters for screens people read at 2am. …"
props.description: One or two sentences under the meta line. An empty string hides it.

props.name: stats
props.description: The figures row: { label, value, tracksFollow? }[]. true shows the defaults, false hides the row. A stat with tracksFollow ticks up by one while the viewer follows.

props.name: layout
props.description: vertical is a centred portrait card; horizontal puts the avatar left, actions top right and the stats along the foot (actions drop under the bio in narrow containers).

props.name: followed
props.description: Controlled follow state. Leave it out to let the card keep its own.

props.name: onFollowChange
props.description: Runs with the next state on every Follow press.

props.name: onMessage
props.description: Runs when the message button is pressed.

props.name: unfollowLabel
props.description: Shown on hover while following, once the pointer has left the button and come back.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for the figures and the clock.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour: the avatar ring and the Following check.
